newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-FOMC wait keeps grip on Australian bond trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-FOMC wait keeps grip on Australian bond trade.

text.p: *Australian bonds should see busier trading conditions on Wednesday once the key FOMC meeting is out of the way and the local market turns back to its own positive fundamentals.
*RBA's Macfarlane to give inaugural speech on Wednesday.

Australian bonds suffered another lacklustre trading session as investors generally stood aside ahead of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee meeting on Tuesday night, and where a policy tightening could be endorsed.
However, traders said the market should see busier trading conditions on Wednesday once the policy-making meeting is out of the way and returns to its own local positive fundamentals.

A 25 basis point hike in the Fed funds rate has been factored in, but comments by the Fed will be equally as important if it does go ahead with its first rate increase in some 1-1/2 years, analysts said.

"It will be important that the Fed categorises a tightening as insurance against inflation at some point getting out of control, even though there is no sign of it at the moment," said Stephen Roberts, chief economist at UBS Australia.
"In those terms it shouldn't be too alarming for the market," he added.

While initial trading on Wednesday will be largely focussed on the outcome of the meeting, the market may get some insight into local monetary policy when the Reserve Bank's Ian Macfarlane delivers his inaugral speech as governor at an economists conference in Canberra.

Local bond yields were marginally lower, mirroring moves in U.S. Treasuries, which kept spreads between the two in a tight range for much of the day. The long-end of the New Zealand curve outperformed amid aggressive buying by one bank, although the short-end was depressed by stronger than expected wages data.

The 10-year bond continues to sustain last week's break above 92.000, but resistance is holding at the recent dayside high of 92.080. A breach of 92.000 should find a solid band of support between 91.960 and 91.920.
